node: Employer tuition assistance, workforce-training, and career-pathway platforms
summary: Layer 1B expands the public-market universe around employer-funded education distribution, tuition-benefit administration, workforce-training platforms, and career-pathway services. The best-supported reference anchor is Strategic Education because its own public site states it owns a tuition-assistance platform and partners with employers on accredited degrees, non-degree skill pathways, coding schools, and workforce solutions. The underfollowed lane includes Grand Canyon Education, Stride, and Nelnet as plausible second-order or adjacent assets: GCE through employer and educational agreements tied to workforce and licensure programs; Stride through career learning, professional skills training, and talent development; and Nelnet through education technology services, payments, and administrative infrastructure that may sit behind education-benefit workflows. Several claims remain hypotheses because the provided evidence supports node adjacency but not yet segment-level revenue exposure to employer tuition benefits.
